title: Oozy Umami Ethiopian Lentils Shiro
description: A hearty, comforting Ethiopian dish featuring rich lentils in a savory plum sauce, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients to promote balance and well-being.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, allowing the flavors to meld.
Add the rinsed lentils, plum sauce, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Use an immersion blender to partially puree the lentils, creating a creamy and oozy texture.
Serve the shiro hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
